Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Pallavi - 62 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Suresh - 37 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Shalini - 28 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Anita - 36 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram stands in the ward. Pallavi, Suresh and Anita stand near him.]

Vikram: "Suresh, what's the plan today?"

[Mother passes away, and Vikram covers her body with a white sheet.]

Suresh: "Rest in peace."
